filer_name.rationale: No dedicated filer name element exists at the form root; PersonNm under SpecifiedIndivOrPersonInfo is the closest name field, but it refers to the specified individual/entity, not the top-of-form filer name — blueprint should be mapped to a header-level name element not present in this candidate list.

filer_tin.rationale: No dedicated top-of-form TIN element exists at the form root; SSN under SpecifiedIndivOrPersonInfo is the closest, but it refers to the specified individual context, not the filer header TIN — blueprint should map to a header-level SSN/ITIN element not present in this candidate list.

tax_year.rationale: CalendarYr maps directly to the tax year indicated on the form header.

foreign_deposit_custodial_accounts.rationale: ForeignFinclAccountGrp is the repeating group element for Part I foreign deposit/custodial accounts; blueprint bundles multiple accounts as an array matching this repeating group.

part_i_total_maximum_value.rationale: No single canonical element represents the combined total maximum value of all Part I accounts; MaxAllFrgnDepositAcctValueAmt and MaxAllFrgnCstdAcctValueAmt are separate, and no combined Part I total element exists in the candidate list — blueprint should split into two fields: max_all_foreign_deposit_acct_value and max_all_foreign_custodial_acct_value.

other_foreign_assets.rationale: OtherForeignAssetGrp is the repeating group element for Part II other specified foreign financial assets.

part_ii_total_maximum_value.rationale: MaxAllFrgnAssetValueAmt captures the total maximum value of all other foreign assets in Part II.

interest_income.rationale: ReportedOnFormOrScheduleAmt under ForeignFinclAccountSumGrp/InterestSumGrp matches interest income reported for foreign financial accounts; however the blueprint does not distinguish FFA vs OFA summary — closest match given Part III context.

interest_income_form_and_line.rationale: WhereReportedFormAndLineTxt under ForeignFinclAccountSumGrp/InterestSumGrp matches the form and line reference for interest income reporting location.

dividend_income.rationale: ReportedOnFormOrScheduleAmt under ForeignFinclAccountSumGrp/DividendSumGrp matches dividend income reported for Part III.

dividend_income_form_and_line.rationale: WhereReportedFormAndLineTxt under ForeignFinclAccountSumGrp/DividendSumGrp matches the form and line reference for dividend income.

royalty_income.rationale: ReportedOnFormOrScheduleAmt under ForeignFinclAccountSumGrp/RoyaltySumGrp matches royalty income reported for Part III.

royalty_income_form_and_line.rationale: WhereReportedFormAndLineTxt under ForeignFinclAccountSumGrp/RoyaltySumGrp matches the form and line reference for royalty income.

other_income.rationale: ReportedOnFormOrScheduleAmt under ForeignFinclAccountSumGrp/OtherIncomeSumGrp matches other income reported for Part III.

other_income_form_and_line.rationale: WhereReportedFormAndLineTxt under ForeignFinclAccountSumGrp/OtherIncomeSumGrp matches the form and line reference for other income.

gains_losses.rationale: ReportedOnFormOrScheduleAmt under ForeignFinclAccountSumGrp/GainLossSumGrp matches net gains or losses reported for Part III.

gains_losses_form_and_line.rationale: WhereReportedFormAndLineTxt under ForeignFinclAccountSumGrp/GainLossSumGrp matches the form and line reference for gains or losses.

deductions.rationale: ReportedOnFormOrScheduleAmt under ForeignFinclAccountSumGrp/DeductionSumGrp matches deductions reported for Part III.

deductions_form_and_line.rationale: WhereReportedFormAndLineTxt under ForeignFinclAccountSumGrp/DeductionSumGrp matches the form and line reference for deductions.

credits.rationale: ReportedOnFormOrScheduleAmt under ForeignFinclAccountSumGrp/CreditSumGrp matches credits reported for Part III.

credits_form_and_line.rationale: WhereReportedFormAndLineTxt under ForeignFinclAccountSumGrp/CreditSumGrp matches the form and line reference for credits.

form_3520_filed.rationale: Form3520Cnt corresponds to Part IV line 8 tracking of Form 3520 filings; blueprint uses boolean while canonical uses count, but this is the closest match.

form_3520_a_filed.rationale: Form3520ACnt corresponds to Part IV line 9 tracking of Form 3520-A filings.

form_5471_filed.rationale: Form5471Cnt corresponds to Part IV line 10 tracking of Form 5471 filings.

form_8621_filed.rationale: Form8621Cnt corresponds to Part IV line 11 tracking of Form 8621 filings.

form_8865_filed.rationale: Form8865Cnt corresponds to Part IV line 12 tracking of Form 8865 filings.

form_8891_filed.rationale: No Form8891Cnt or equivalent element exists in the candidate list; Form 8891 was obsoleted and removed from the MeF schema, so there is no canonical element to match.

total_assets_maximum_value.rationale: No single canonical element represents the combined Part I plus Part II aggregate maximum value; the schema splits this into separate deposit, custodial, and other asset maximum amounts — blueprint should split into the individual component fields.

filing_status.rationale: No filing status element exists in the IRS8938 candidate list; filing status is on the primary return (Form 1040) and not captured in the 8938 schema.

lives_abroad.rationale: No lives-abroad or bona-fide-residence indicator element exists in the IRS8938 candidate list; this threshold qualifier is not represented in the schema.
